list.title: Saray Managpaalagey tan Proyekto
list.hint: Saray builder et onloob ed builder portal pian awaten iray referral parad saray proyekto ra tan kumpirmaen iray booking.

detail.deactivateHint: No i-deactivate, amin ya manguusar ed sayan builder et ompaway lan tampol.
detail.resetPrompt: Balon password parad {{name}} (ag-onkulang ed 8 karakter). Sikaray i-sign out ed inerman a pasen.
detail.projectsHint: Saray kasosyo et manpipili ed saray aktibon proyekto no manrerehistro na lead; say referral et onla ed sayan managpaalagey.

protection.placeholder: Saray agew na proteksion (anggapoy karga = global default)
protection.saved: In-update so proteksion ed duplicate parad {{name}} .
protection.hint: Proteksion ed duplicate: 1-3650 ya agew, odino paulyanan ya anggapoy karga pian nausar so global default manlapud Settings. Say pananguman et onaplika labat ed saray balon rehistrasyon - saray wala la et mansiansian expire.

matching.hint: Anto ran detalye so manggawa ed duaran rehistrasyon ya parehon kustomer parad sakey a proyekto. Saray pananguman et onaplika ed saray duplikadon tseke manlapud natan; ag naapektoan so walan proteksion.
